newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwan Wing in cash offer for Silver Eagle.
newsitem.headline: Kwan Wing in cash offer for Silver Eagle.

text.p: Kwan Wing Holdings Ltd (KWH) said on Monday it was making a cash offer of HK$1.76 per ordinary share and HK$4.51 per preference share of Silver Eagle Holdings Ltd, valuing Silver Eagle at HK$573.76 million.

KWH is obliged to make a cash offer for the consumer products maker because it will hold 138 million ordinary shares or 66.42 percent of the enlarged share capital of Silver Eagle after it exercises conversion rights attached to 53.82 million Silver Eagle preference shares, the joint statememt said.
KWH holds a total 99.99 million Silver Eagle preference shares prior to the conversion.
The statement said KWH had no present intention to exercise its conversion rights attached to the remaining preference shares which would allow KWH to hold up to 79 percent of Silver Eagle.
It is the intention of KWH to maintain the listing of Silver Eagle on the Hong Kong stock exchange, it said.
KWH had in January 1997 bought the 99.99 million Silver Eagle preference shares from Grande Holdings Ltd for HK$140 million.

On completion of the conversion, Grande Holdings' stake in Silver Eagle will be diluted to 12 percent from 37 percent, while public stake in Silver Eagle will be reduced to 21 percent from 37 percent.

As the public shareholding fell below the required 25 percent level, Silver Eagle has undertaken to the stock exchange to take appropriate steps to ensure that not less than 25 percent of Silver Eagle shares will be held by the public.
KWH also holds about 29.8 percent stake in telecommunication equipment maker Universal Appliances Ltd.
Silver Eagle shares which were suspended on June 3, resumed trade on Monday. Its shares jumped HK$1.24 or 70.45 percent to HK$3.00 in early trade.
